summary: Section 319 Cr.P.C. applicability; sanction under PC Act and Cr.P.C.; consistent testimony on police extortion; Rs.50,000 demand vs Rs.24 lakhs allegations; witness credibility; no counterblast due to testimony; High Court dismissal reversed; summoning order upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.7, s.13(2)
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upholding summoning order confirmed; appellant to face trial.
